partner_result_applied.statement: For every fixed symmetric A of rank at least 3 and arbitrary independent cap-one marginals, X^TAX has an instance-dependent bounded density in C_0(R).

new_results: Every nonconstant quadratic polynomial maps an absolutely continuous joint law to an absolutely continuous output law by coarea.
Exact zero-loss analytic-Schwartz reduction: the sharp full QFORM constant equals the supremum restricted to s_3(A)=1 and strictly positive real-analytic Schwartz marginals bounded by one.
Equivalent bad-sequence normal form with normalized matrices, analytic-Schwartz cap-one product inputs, C_0 output densities, attained maxima and diverging peak heights.
unpaid_implication: Prove a universal bound for max_t p_(X^TAX)(t) on the normalized analytic-Schwartz subclass; smoothness seminorms are not uniformly controlled, so derivative-dependent estimates do not close the problem.
